Query: Give me the total salary of the Oviedo football players.
Eval Rationale: The Candidate contains a significant type error in its aggregation logic: it attempts to perform a SUM on 'r1' (a relationship) using an attribute 'salary' that belongs to the relationship, whereas salary is an attribute of the player entity. While the graph topology (Club -> Player) and the name constraint are correctly captured, the target expression is semantically invalid because relationships do not hold the salary attribute in this schema; it should have been mapped from the player entity.
